items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Cause Paul Chambers, boy, that fellow had me uptight there, boy.

ctx.x: You know, played all the music. And Arthur Edgehill was on the drums. He played OK. I was just-- that was my first uh, like I said, first jazz gig, man, and I was excited and scared to death, man. Cause Paul Chambers, boy, that fellow had me uptight there, boy. Good God, give me some room to breathe in here, man. Let me relax. And so Kenny had--I'd like you to know he was a fast driver, you know. He had a convertible Ford. He bought himself a convertible--convertible, man. And so we was supposed to be playing in…
